use default

riordan(count: int) -> Pipe[bigint] is
    let previous mut = 1n
    let current mut = 0n

    yield previous

    for index in 1..count do
        yield current

        let following =
            cast(index) *
            (2n * current + 3n * previous) /
            cast(index + 2)

        previous = current
        current = following
    od
si

let first = riordan(32) |> collect_list()

for row in 0..8 do
    let line = first[row * 4..row * 4 + 4] |> map(term => "{term,14}")

    write_line(line |> join(""))
od

digits(index: int) -> int =>
    (riordan(index + 1) |> collect_list())[index].to_string().length

write_line("")
write_line("the 1,000th Riordan number has {digits(1_000)} digits")
write_line("the 10,000th has {digits(10_000)} digits")
